searchTerms.title: Keywords
searchTerms.description: One keyword or phrase per line. Each is searched in every country you list below, so 3 keywords x 2 countries = 6 searches.

advertisers.title: Advertisers (Ad Library page URLs or page ids)
advertisers.description: Pull every ad from a specific advertiser. Paste the Ad Library URL of the advertiser (the one containing view_all_page_id=...) or just the numeric page id. A plain facebook.com/<slug> URL will NOT work here: the Ad Library addresses advertisers by numeric id only, and this actor tells you rather than silently returning nothing.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: ISO country codes to search. The Ad Library is country-scoped, so a term with no ads in one country legitimately returns zero there.

adType.title: Ad category
adType.description: 'All ads' covers commercial advertising. The political & issue category is the only one where Facebook publishes spend and impression ranges - for every other category those fields come back empty, by Meta's policy and not because they were missed.
enumTitles: Political and issue ads (has spend + impressions)

activeStatus.title: Active status
activeStatus.description: Whether to return ads currently running, ads that have stopped, or both.

searchType.title: Keyword match
searchType.description: Unordered matches the words in any order; exact phrase matches the phrase as typed.

mediaType.title: Creative type
mediaType.description: Restrict to image, video or meme creatives.

publisherPlatforms.title: Platforms
publisherPlatforms.description: Restrict to ads delivered on these Meta surfaces. Leave empty for all of them.

contentLanguages.title: Ad languages
contentLanguages.description: Two-letter language codes, e.g. en, id, es. Leave empty for any language.

startDateFrom.title: First shown on or after
startDateFrom.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Filters on the day the ad started running.

maxAdsPerQuery.title: Max ads per search
maxAdsPerQuery.description: Facebook server-renders the first 30 ads; anything beyond that is fetched by replaying its own pagination query, 30 at a time. Keep this low while you are tuning a search.

onlyActive.title: Only ads still running
onlyActive.description: Drop ads Facebook reports as no longer active.
onlyActive.groupDescription: Applied to what Facebook returned, after fetching, so the run summary still counts everything.

onlyWithVideo.title: Only ads with video
onlyWithVideo.description: Keep only creatives that carry at least one video file.

minRunningDays.title: Minimum days on air
minRunningDays.description: Long-running ads are the ones an advertiser kept paying for. Ads with no usable flight dates are dropped rather than admitted on a guess.

adTextContains.title: Ad copy contains
adTextContains.description: Case-insensitive substring match across the ad body, headline, caption and link description.

emitSummary.title: Add a run summary record
emitSummary.description: Append one RUN_SUMMARY record: ads collected, how many are active, how many advertisers and the median days on air.

exportFormats.title: Extra export files
exportFormats.description: Also write the results to the key-value store in these formats. The dataset is always produced regardless.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Recommended on the Apify platform if you want more than the first 30 ads of each search. Facebook serves the rendered first page fine from any IP, but on Apify's datacenter IPs it answers the very first pagination request with "Rate limit exceeded" - measured 2026-09-20. Switching the Apify proxy on with the RESIDENTIAL group restored full pagination in the same test (60 ads over 4 pages against 30). Running from your own machine, no proxy is needed at all. The actor logs a warning naming this when it happens, so a short run is never silently mistaken for a short result set.
